name: codex-tps-plus
description: Local automatic generation TPS estimates with optional query skills; hooks never call a model.

interface.shortDescription: Local generation TPS estimates with no model requests.
interface.longDescription: Runs local Stop hooks without model requests. Shows complete generation TPS or a measured subset with explicit coverage. Complete and partial histories remain separate. Optional tps and tps-doctor skills provide convenient queries.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest generation TPS estimate or explain why timing is unavailable.
